STREAMLINED HIRING

How AEGIS Works

A 3-step transparent orchestration engine designed for candidates and hiring panels.

1

Explore & Apply

Candidates discover curated engineering roles and submit applications with automated blind skill extraction to eliminate demographic bias.

2

Calibrated Evaluation

Interview panels receive candidate-specific question sets with clear 5-point grading benchmarks to ensure standardized, fair assessment.

3

Live SLA Tracking

Track your application across all 8 journey stages in real-time, backed by SLA escalation and a guaranteed 48-hour feedback commitment.

INTELLIGENT CAPABILITIES

Core Platform Features

Engineered to eliminate hiring black holes and replace guesswork with verifiable fairness.

01

Blind Resume Screening

Skills and technical architecture experience are evaluated objectively with zero visibility of candidate names, photos, or demographic indicators.

02

Guaranteed SLA Transparency

Every phase has an unskippable turnaround timeline. Automated escalation prevents candidates from waiting indefinitely.

03

Tailored Interview Rubrics

Panelists receive objective, candidate-specific question sets and calibrated 5-point benchmarks to eliminate subjective bias.

OUR COMMITMENT

Real Status, Predictable Timelines

Every interviewed candidate receives constructive scorecard feedback within 48 hours of evaluation. Records can never be closed silently.
